subject: Your Bass Booster just got louder
preview_text: We added a new audio profile that makes earbuds hit like subwoofers. Open it now.
body_paragraphs: 48 days ago you downloaded Bass Booster. Since then, something changed. We added a new audio profile called 'Sub Slam' — designed specifically for earbuds that lack low-end. Hip-Hop drops, EDM buildups, and rock breakdowns now hit like a live subwoofer, even on cheap buds.

Here's the thing: most people never touch the EQ after the first week. They forget the app exists. But the drop you're missing right now — that chest-punch feeling — it's not your speakers. It's your settings. You already have the tool; you just haven't used it since the update.

Open the app, tap the 'Music' profile, and drag the 31Hz slider up to +6dB. Then play your favorite track. Your phone will literally vibrate in your hand. That's not placebo — it's physics. We rebuilt the bass virtualizer to push more air through earbuds. Try it once and you'll hear the difference immediately.

Open Bass Booster now and test the new Sub Slam profile on your go-to song. Just one minute of your time. P.S. If you haven't tried the 200% volume boost yet, do it after the EQ adjustment — it'll melt your face off. Premium users get unlimited access to both.
